explain_question:
The user's last message: {text}

Explain the result in plain language, in the language of that message. Start with the concrete thing that did not work and why, not with the task status or plan counts. Synthesize the whole context: what happened and why, what is now blocked or waiting, what the runtime will do next on its own, and what — if anything — the user must decide. If the task is not complete, name the real cause from the evidence, not a generic "process error". Do not restate the status dump, do not list raw fields, and do not invent facts. If nothing is needed from the user, say so directly.
explain_state_question: Explain the current state in plain language, in the language of the user's message. Synthesize the plan and the latest result: what happened, what is blocked or waiting, what the runtime will do next on its own, and what — if anything — the user must decide. Do not restate the status dump or invent facts.
explain_missing_model: No model is configured, so this result cannot be explained in plain language. Task {task}: {status}. Reports: {reports}.
explain_failed: I couldn't explain the result just now. The task is {status}. Reports: {reports}.
waiting: Waiting for a scheduled retry at {moment} (about {minutes} min). Ctrl-C returns to the prompt.
stopped: Stopped waiting; the retry stays scheduled.
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed: {error}. It stopped before the next step. Fix the cause and retry.
failure_question: The operation failed before it could continue. Explain in plain language what happened, why it stopped, and what the owner should do next. Use only the error and context.
failure_default: The operation could not be completed: {error}. It stopped before the next step. Fix the cause and retry.

help:
Forgel

Talk in plain language. I decide what to do: answer, queue a code change,
plan a milestone, show the state, accept or send work back, retry, pause, or
adopt a repository. You do not need to remember commands.

Examples
  adopt this repository
  plan the milestone: bring the project to M1
  what is happening?
  accept the latest task
  send it back: the header is wrong
  retry the failed task
  work in peak hours / only off-peak
  pause / resume

Entry points and sensitive operations stay explicit
/adopt <url> [| brief]   adopt a repository and select it
/new <name> | <brief>    create a template project
/secret ...              secret names, set, delete
/config [set ...]        effective settings
/help
/quit                    exit the console

Project ids can be shortened to any unique prefix. Secrets sent to a bot pass
through Telegram, which has no end-to-end encryption for bots; prefer
environment variables or `forgel secret set` over SSH in production.
chat_empty: Send a command or a message. /help
chat_approval_expired: This approval request expired. Run /approve again.
chat_new_usage:
Usage: /new <name> | <brief>
or: /new <brief> to derive the name.
chat_new_created:
Project {project} created and selected.
The daemon will run it and report back.
chat_adopt_usage:
Usage: /adopt <repository-url> [| brief]
Supports GitHub URLs, SSH remotes, owner/repo and local paths.
chat_adopted_linked: Adopted the folder in place as {project} and selected it.
chat_brownfield_in_place: Mode: brownfield — the source folder is the repository; there is no second copy.
chat_brownfield_no_regen: Mode: brownfield — Forgel will not regenerate this repository.
chat_config_initialized: Config initialized in program/forgel.toml and program.yaml.
chat_no_origin: No origin remote was found. The folder stays local; configure GitHub and ask me to publish it, or add a remote yourself.
chat_github_private: GitHub: {detail}. For private repositories and later push/PR set FORGEL_GITHUB_TOKEN on the host or /secret set github.token <token>; a fine-grained token needs Contents read/write.
chat_link_hint: If a related repository belongs here, tell me to add it and which repository it depends on.
chat_link_when: Link repositories only when their code depends on each other (for example a frontend consumes a backend contract). Independent repositories can be linked, but Forgel will simply maintain them separately.
chat_repo_none: This project has no repositories recorded.
chat_repo_created: Created {repo} at {url} and added it to {project}.
chat_repo_usage: Usage: /repo list, /repo add <url> [id] [depends_on=<id,id>], /repo create <id>, /repo publish [id] or /repo link <id> depends_on=<id,id>
chat_repo_separate: No dependency edges recorded: this repository is maintained separately inside the project.
chat_tasks_none: No tasks. A change request sent as a plain message queues one.
chat_control_moved: Project state moved to {path}. The product repository no longer tracks it.
chat_use_selected:
Selected {name} ({project}).
State: {state}.
Messages without a command now go to this project's agent.
chat_run_gateway: This gateway does not run iterations. Run `forgel run {project}` on the host.
chat_daemon_paused: The daemon is paused. Send /resume first.
chat_run_state: {project}: {state}. The daemon will process queued tasks.
chat_run_brownfield: {project} is a brownfield project: the template pipeline does not run. Send a change request as a plain message or inspect it with /status.
chat_run_queued: {project} is queued; the daemon will run it in this cycle.
chat_sync_pending: External changes: {count} file(s). A decision is required.
chat_production_needs_release:
Production approval requires a completed release.
Current checkpoint: {checkpoint}. Approve staging and let the daemon finish it first.
chat_plan_queued: The daemon runs them in order; a task waits for its dependencies.
chat_config_restart: Restart the gateway to apply it.
chat_secret_note: Telegram bots have no end-to-end encryption. This message is deleted after the command, but prefer environment variables or `forgel secret set` over SSH in production.
chat_secret_hint: Set with /secret set <key> <value>; the message is deleted.
chat_secret_restart: Restart the gateway to use a new telegram.bot_token.
chat_secret_saved: Saved {key} to {file} (mode 0600). The value was not echoed and the source message is being deleted.{restart}{note}
chat_secret_missing: {key} is not set in the file.
chat_pause: The daemon is paused. Tell me to resume when you want it running again.
chat_action_no_decision: There is no task waiting for that decision.
chat_action_no_url: Tell me the repository URL or path.
chat_action_no_repo_id: Tell me the new repository id.
chat_action_not_allowed: I can't perform that action. Configuration, secrets and production approval stay explicit.
chat_secret_looks: This looks like a secret and was not processed. Use /secret set <key> <value>; the message is being deleted.
chat_agent_missing: The project agent is not configured. Set FORGEL_MODEL_API_KEY on the host or use /secret set model.api_key <value>, then restart the gateway.
chat_approval_gate: The project stays at the approval gate. Use /sync to start a new generation, then decide again.
chat_approval_production_manual: No deploy provider is configured, so this release stays manual; the approval is recorded in the ledger and docs/program/approvals.md.
chat_approval_next_cycle: The daemon will continue on its next cycle.
chat_production_prompt:
Production approval for {name} ({project}), generation {generation}.

Forgel is a software development tool, not a law firm. Jurisdiction packs are advisory and do not establish legal compliance. By accepting, you confirm that you are responsible for the product's regulatory compliance in its target markets. See docs/program/jurisdiction/disclaimer.md.

Approve production?
chat_github_dns: GitHub API is not reachable by DNS. Check VPN/network and retry the same command.
chat_github_app_permission: The GitHub App cannot perform this action. Grant the installation repository administration/creation for the organization, or use a PAT with repo scope.
chat_github_auth: GitHub authentication failed. Set FORGEL_GITHUB_TOKEN on the host or /secret set github.token <token>; a fine-grained token needs Contents read/write.
chat_project_gone: The selected project no longer exists. Use /projects.
peak_defer: Model work is paused during {model} peak hours ({windows}, weekdays). The window closes at {moment} (in {wait}); work resumes automatically. Override: /peak always or [models] peak_policy = "always".
peak_allowed: Running at peak rates is allowed.
peak_deferred: Model work is deferred during peak windows.
tg_online: Forgel gateway is online. Daemon: {mode}. Agent: {agent}. /help
tg_staging_rejected:
Staging was rejected for {project}.
Change the scope with /sync, then approve the next generation.
tg_failed:
{project} stopped at stage {stage}.
Check /status {project} and the daemon log.
tg_task_pending: A task is queued for {name} ({project}). The daemon will start it in this cycle.
tg_delete_warning: Warning: the source message could not be deleted; delete it manually.
